title: Platform Ramp: 0 → 1 → 3 → 10 → Global

stages.label: Qualify
stages.question: Should Pivora take this platform?
stages.focus: Differentiation, enterprise value, ACV/TCV potential, proof of value, competitive position, executive commitment, delivery readiness, market appetite, partner readiness, realistic investment

stages.label: Find the wedge
stages.question: Can we create one strategically valuable win?
stages.focus: Smallest credible wedge, lighthouse customer, tight account universe, few high-value use cases, executive relationships, a small number of serious partners

stages.label: Prove repeatability
stages.question: Can we repeat why customers buy?
stages.focus: Reason-to-buy documentation, influence map, objection patterns, partner contribution, conversion path, ICP refinement, references, playbook

stages.label: Scale
stages.question: Can the motion scale without losing quality?
stages.focus: Account coverage, partner leverage, GCC's and GSI's expansion, marketing-to-sales orchestration, institutionalised forecasting

stages.label: Institutionalise
stages.question: Can India become a route to wider growth?
stages.focus: Strategic growth orchestration, executive advisory, ecosystem development, GTM optimisation, global replication

caption: Stage 0 is a genuine qualification gate. Pivora declines platforms that fail it.
